cards.title: Comparatives
cards.body: Compare two things. Short adj: -er. Long adj: more + adj. Always than.
cards.body_cz: Porovnej dvě věci. Krátké: -er. Dlouhé: more + adj. Vždy than.

cards.title: Superlatives
cards.body: Compare one with a group. the + -est / the most.
cards.body_cz: Jeden z celé skupiny. the + -est / the most.
points: She is the tallest in the class.
It is the most expensive hotel.

cards.title: than
points: bigger than that car · taller than me
Not: bigger of · Not: more bigger
much better · far worse · a lot faster — not more better

cards.title: Comparing how, not what
cards.body: An adverb describes the verb — how something is done. It compares the same way: short adverbs take -er, longer ones take more.
cards.body_cz: Příslovce popisuje sloveso — jak se něco dělá. Porovnává se stejně: krátká berou -er, delší more.
points: Longer adverb ending -ly (slowly, carefully) → more + adverb
well → better: She speaks English better than me.
